title: AI in Control
subtitle: Let predictions steer the rover
description: Use AI predictions to find the supply stations in Sector 4 and deliver emergency packages.
story: Two supply stations in Sector 4 have been cut off since the storm. The rover is carrying packages, but nobody can drive it manually — the link is too slow. From here on, the AI decides.
learningObjectives: Predictions can be connected directly to robot actions
A confident wrong answer is more dangerous than an unsure one
Fallback logic protects a system when the model is uncertain
Autonomy means deciding when NOT to act

objectives.description: Deliver packages to both supply stations
Enter no more than two hazard tiles

failureConditions.message: The rover ran out of battery before finishing its deliveries.
Time ran out before both stations were supplied.
The rover was damaged beyond safe operation.

hints: You need a storage compartment. Without one the rover has nothing to deliver.
The camera looks at the tile directly in front of the rover, so 'Deliver supply' fires when the rover is facing a station.
Fit the Radio Link so the 'Ask a human' action actually works. Without it the rover just stops.
Set your confidence threshold in the AI Lab. Acting on a 40% prediction is how autonomous systems cause accidents.
reflectionQuestions: What confidence threshold did you choose, and what happened when you raised or lowered it?
When should a robot stop and ask a human instead of deciding by itself?
Did asking for help cost you points or save you points overall?
